summary: xAI announced that Grok Build, its coding agent and terminal UI harness, is now open-sourced on GitHub and can run fully local-first against user-provided inference.

practices.reason: The open-sourced agent loop and extension system (skills, plugins, hooks, MCP servers, subagents) give engineers a concrete reference for building or extending their own agent scaffolding.
practices.quote: if you're working with skills, plugins, hooks, MCP servers, or subagents, the source is the definitive reference for how each is loaded and invoked

practices.reason: Local-first operation lets teams point the harness at their own inference backend, changing what needs to be wired up for self-hosted deployments.
practices.quote: Grok Build can now run fully local-first: compile it yourself, point it at your own local inference, and drive everything from your config.toml .
